archetype_rationale: AI automation for specialty-drug access (prior auth, benefits verification, fax processing) in clinics - healthcare admin workflow layer.

gates.rationale: Administrative automation, not clinical care or licensed advice

1.evidence: article: agents for prior-auth/insurance-verification/fax - document+RPA stack buildable

2.evidence: admin-workflow agents fully replicable with FM APIs + portal automation

3.evidence: 'prior-auth agent for one specialty' small scope

4.evidence: EHR/payer-portal integration heavy and brittle per article

5.evidence: payer portals/EHR data accessible but permissioned

7.evidence: months to first workflow live incl. compliance review

9.evidence: 'prior-auth automation' package is a crisp productized offer

11.evidence: workflow templates reusable across specialty clinics

15.evidence: approval turnaround + staff-hours anchors direct and provable

17.evidence: clinic admin budgets real and pain-driven

22.evidence: article: Greylock, SignalFire, Maverick, SV Angel; Jerry Yang, Rauch angels

24.evidence: healthcare-admin AI among hottest practical verticals

26.evidence: article: 700+ clinics, 250k+ new patients annually - exceptional proof

27.evidence: specialty clinics hyper-reachable to agencies with HIPAA chops

28.evidence: workflow IP moderate; payer-rule knowledge accumulates

44.evidence: EHR incumbents building native agents over time

45.evidence: FM vendors ship document intelligence; payer portals stay the moat

46.evidence: automation patterns copy fast; payer knowledge persists

48.evidence: portable to other admin-heavy verticals (billing, referrals)

agency_play.build_scope: Partial functionality: prior-auth/benefits-verification agents for one specialty at a time on FM document APIs + browser automation against payer portals, under clinic BAA - Mandolin's wedge without the platform.
agency_play.packaging: Productized 'Prior-Auth Desk' per specialty: setup + per-transaction managed processing; monthly outcome report.
agency_play.first_clients: Oncology, rheumatology and infusion groups drowning in prior-auth faxes - listable via specialty societies.
